The Company’s financial outlook and other projections in this press release are based on management’s current expectations and assumptions and are particularly subject to these risks.

dropped.t: (Nasdaq: XTIA) (“XTI Aerospace,” “XTI” or the “Company”), an aerospace and advanced technology platform and parent company of Drone Nerds, LLC (“Drone Nerds”), a leading drone solutions platform serving commercial, enterprise and government customers, today announced that its internal review, initiated in July 2026, has been completed and the Company is on track to file its Form 10-Q by October 26, 2026.

“With the internal review complete, I am happy to report that there were no financial misstatements discovered and we are on track to report our second quarter results later this month,” said Jeremy Schneiderman, Interim CEO.

Consistent with its ongoing commitment to strong corporate governance, the Company intends to implement, under the oversight of the Board of Directors, certain enhancements to its governance framework, policies and procedures.
The Board will continue to evaluate the Company’s governance practices and may adopt additional measures as it deems appropriate.
The Company anticipates reporting second quarter revenue of approximately $32.4 million, gross profit of approximately $5.6 million and loss from operations of approximately $9.1 million.
The Company is withdrawing its previously issued 2026 financial guidance at this time and expects to provide a comprehensive update at a later date.

risks_dropped.t: changes in domestic and foreign business, market, financial, political and legal conditions
the risk that XTI’s common stock is suspended from trading or delisted
the risk that XTI’s planned governance, policy and procedural enhancements are not implemented in a timely manner or do not achieve their intended benefits
XTI’s successful integration of any products (including achievement of synergies and cost reductions)
XTI’s ability to successfully and timely develop, sell and expand its services, and otherwise implement its growth strategy
risks relating to potential disruption of current plans, operations and infrastructure of XTI, including as a result of the consummation of any acquisition
risks that XTI is unable to secure or protect its intellectual property
risks that XTI experiences difficulties managing its growth and expanding operations
